findings.what: save() is not wrapped in error handling; a DB failure throws out of the server action, the user sees an error boundary, and their input is lost with no 'failed to send' message
Length limits use UTF-16 .length, so emoji/astral characters count double against the 100/2000 character limits
Single-file SQLite at cwd/data via experimental node:sqlite; messages won't persist on serverless/read-only deployments and this limit is not documented
Navigation/label/escaping tests regex the source text instead of rendering pages, so they are weak regression protection
